Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You see the mistake a heartbeat after it happens, and your correction lands before the failure settles.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One ally within 5 squares that can hear and understand you, after a Weak result on that ally’s attack or skill roll.
Duration
Immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per round; uses your Reaction.
Type
Signature

Diagnose the mistake and show the ally the correction. The ally may reroll the roll with 1 Boon. The reroll is part of your Reaction; the ally keeps their own Reaction.

Additional rulings
